other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand
Applicant must be engaged in any building or construction work
Applicant must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
Applicant must have an active membership of the Board
Eligibility begins only after three months from registration
Applicant must not be receiving the same benefits under any other central or state scheme
Applicant must not have applied for the same benefits in any other department
For registration, the worker must have completed 18 years of age and not completed 60 years
The worker must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding one year
benefits_summary: Sanitary napkins are provided to daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers.
